overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: although a quorum attended a social event, the evidence did not show they deliberated on committee business, so the complaint was resolved.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that a quorum of the school committee deliberated outside a posted meeting at a social event held at a member's home on April 9.
allegations.key_passage: For these reasons, we do not find that a quorum of the Committee deliberated at the April 9 social event and we do not find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law.
